proof_body:
by
  intro f a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩ ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := hL (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x y hx hx' hy hy' => ?_⟩
    have h1 := h x hx hx'
    have h2 := h y hy hy'
    have e : f x - f y = (f x - L) - (f y - L) := by ring
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ |f x - L| + |f y - L| := abs_sub _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
  · intro h
    have hpt : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < |a + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - a| := fun n => by
      have : a + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - a = 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
      rw [this]; positivity
    have hsm : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |a + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - a|) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h0 := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)
      refine h0.congr fun n => ?_
      have : a + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - a = 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
      rw [this, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    have hc : CauchySeq (fun n : ℕ => f (a + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) := by
      rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hd⟩ := h ε hε
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hsm) δ hδ
      have hN' : ∀ n, N ≤ n → |a + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - a| < δ := fun n hn => by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hN n hn
      exact ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => by
        rw [Real.dist_eq]; exact hd _ _ (hpt m) (hN' m hm) (hpt n) (hN' n hn)⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hc
    refine ⟨L, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hd⟩ := h (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x hx hx' => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨N₁, h₁⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hsm) δ hδ
    obtain ⟨N₂, h₂⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hL) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    have hn := max_le_iff.1 (le_refl (max N₁ N₂))
    have h3 := hd x _ hx hx' (hpt (max N₁ N₂)) (by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using h₁ _ hn.1)
    have h4 : |f (a + 1 / (((max N₁ N₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) - L| < ε / 2 := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using h₂ _ hn.2
    have e : f x - L = (f x - f (a + 1 / (((max N₁ N₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))) + (f (a + 1 / (((max N₁ N₂ : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1)) - L) := by ring
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ _ := abs_add_le _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
